title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, draw the first loop as a circle with a center at coordinates [0.0273, 0.0273] and a radius of 0.0273. For the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0245. After completing the sketch, apply a uniform scale factor of 0.0547 to the entire sketch. Ensure that the scaled sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Next, extrude the scaled two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a three-dimensional solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be 0.0546875 units in length, 0.0546875 units in width, and 0.7500000000000001 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0273, 0.0273)

# Create the outer circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0273)

# Create the inner circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0245)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the center and radius of the circles
center = (0.0273, 0.0273)
radius_outer = 0.0273
radius_inner = 0.0245

# Create the outer circle
r = r.center(center[0], center[1]).circle(radius_outer)

# Create the inner circle (for the hole)
r = r.circle(radius_inner)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0273, 0.0273)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0273)  # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0246)  # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
